definitions.confirmed_forecast_departures: Departure explicitly triggered by forecast; abandoned cell actually dangerous later within horizon and person absent at confirmation. Observed proxy, not proven prevented injury.
definitions.smoke_dose: Existing ExposureTracker cumulative dose; stops accumulating after incapacitation.
definitions.arrival_times: First arrival among people who reached an available area. Unreached are censored, not assigned zero.
definitions.later_hazard: Person occupied cell in previous horizon before observed smoke >=0.30 or fire clearance violation.
definitions.unsafe_wait: No displacement, mobile, finite hazard ETA minus evacuation ETA <= unsafe-wait margin; same observer both modes.
